function.name: publish_design
function.description: Publish your complete contribution using native typed fields. Write GLSL directly in functions/body strings.

summary.description: What this change adds to the visible scene.

part.description: Your assigned part, registered to its original position in the complete AMD vector.

functions.description: Optional GLSL helper function definitions, or an empty string.

body.description: GLSL function body using the inputs in your brief. End with return vec3(...). The renderer supplies its wrapper and uniforms. Use decimal float literals.

function.name: read_guide
function.description: Read concise renderer semantics and a tested native-call example for your own role.

function.name: review_peer
function.description: Directly review a published peer contribution using the latest scene image. An approval records that version; a revision request is delivered to its designer automatically and reactivates them when needed.

function.name: respond_peer
function.description: Resolve a delivered peer request after inspecting your current contribution. Explain the exact improvement, or why retaining the current design best serves the shared composition.

function.name: inspect_scene
function.description: See a fresh image of the current shared render and all workers’ latest status. Use it to judge your output and integration.

focus.description: The visual details you are checking in this review.

function.name: team_board
function.description: Read the team’s live status and notes, optionally post a concise integration note. Workers continue independently.

note.description: An actionable note to peers; empty to read only.

function.name: read_layer
function.description: Read the exact latest published source for one role.

function.name: finish_layer
function.description: Mark your contribution ready after inspecting your latest successfully published version. Explain the visual evidence briefly.
